_lead: this is a ten-thousand-year high-magic world war fought along one wall that runs the whole seam between two continents, the allied peoples against the demon clans, armies in the millions, heroes who reshape a battlefield and legends who level mountains; so battle gear here looks like gear from a fantasy JRPG of that war, rune-lit, crystal-fed and blessed on the allied side, bone, black obsidian, blood-script and altar-fire on the demon side, never plain medieval kit.
灰: no gunpowder, no guns of any kind. Nothing new is being made; all gear is the leftovers of a fallen luminous empire: ex-legion white plate and half-plate with the crest scraped off, bone-silver thread in the seams gone dull grey, only pieces set with an old glowing core still shine cold white, a lit core-lamp at the belt marks a leader; eastern lords' men in the most complete kits, castle mages with an old inscribed ring on the hand calling fire down from the sky, inquisitor priests carrying a horn-revealing lamp rebuilt from an old core-lamp; northern exiles in half-plate over oiled sheepskin; demon side: newly kindled orange-red fire burning on the horns, bare chests under bearskins, bent iron bars, camp-forged blades and bone, night-demons in dark long cloaks with a burnt-down white candle stub on a cord at the neck, sworn ones with the hood cut away to bare their horns.
白石: no gunpowder, no guns, and mass-produced enchanted armour does not exist yet. The magic is in oaths, crests and the crafts of many peoples: bright full plate with a freshly chiselled sunrise crest that catches real light, sword blades that glow dawn-gold with the faith of the soldiers behind them, priests' blessings on the steel; heavy cavalry plates mixed with pale silver dust that flash cold in the charge; dwarven rune engineers in chisel-hung leather aprons with orichalcum-edged rune shovels whose runes light as they strike; dragonkin in scale-pattern leather with a scale-socket chiselled on the chest and a huge dragon-bone shield; elven wardens with long living-wood bows and bone-set bracers, halflings with little brass bells; demon side: fire-horned warriors bare-chested with blades of black obsidian, the ground glowing molten under their charge, shadow-walkers in tight grey-black leather that never jingles, sworn night-demons with bared horns and eyes that glow in the dark.
灯: no gunpowder, no guns. Handed-down family leather with magic added layer by layer: swords inscribed with a god's name whose edge carries a small blessed light, shield-temple priests in short iron-grey robes with a small inscribed round shield on the back and holy light shining from the bare left palm, dwarven rune shields; from the academy's founding, mages who condense a spell into a blade of light in the hand, spell-corps with a palm-sized beat-bell; soldiers with one or two crystal cells at the belt that, pressed to a hilt, push out a brief spell-blade; at the very end, the first mass-made enchanted plates, white rune lines that flare when struck, full sets only for the front rank; demon side: black-winged archers with long bows and bone javelins, bone shields carved with spell-script, horned shield walls, blood-demons whose swords light a spell circle out of blood as they are drawn, oath priests with torches.
炮: no gunpowder, no guns: everything runs on magic crystals, steam and runes. Mass-produced enchanted armour, white rune lines that flare when struck, front ranks in full sets; furnace armour (enchanted plate with a small crystal-steam furnace on the back, a blue ring glowing in the grille and white steam venting from the top) for elite knights, worn over a quilted liner; crystal-cannon crews in ear-flap leather caps and work aprons; blue-scaled horn-winged dragonkin gunners with bare scaled forearms, red thunder glowing between the scales; griffon riders in light chest-and-rib leather, a white kite on the left shoulder, a long white streamer, short crossbow and net, signallers with flags woven from crystal thread; rune-cut tower shields; demon side: obsidian horn-rings and obsidian blades on fire-horned warriors, blood-lit sword circles, bone-carved shields, thunder-forged iron and great battering shields on bull-demons, four-armed serpent harpooners in seaweed-sinew vests, dream-demons hung with shards of black obsidian mirror.
浮塔: no gunpowder, no guns. Floating towers and fleets: grey issue coats over enchanted half-plate, a leather pouch of crystal cells at the belt; tower crews with chips of floating stone sewn into their gear that drift a little, deep-blue fleet coats with every button in place; furnace-armour knights in the front rank, tower furnace-smiths with pale, warm hands; spell-swords whose runes fire a spell by themselves, beast-hunters with a greatsword in the main hand and a longsword in the off hand; earned white-kite cloaks; demon side: fire-horned warriors in red-bronze breastplates with bare arms, great shields and long-hafted war hammers, vanguard in black leather with a dark-red stripe across the chest and narrow blood-grooved swords, hornless pale long-lived demons in grey wide-sleeved robes with a name embroidered on the left cuff, eyes glowing red, gold or violet, a pale blue-white bone bow, winged raiders hurling bone javelins at the towers, oath priests with filed-down horn tips.
铁狼: no gunpowder, no guns. Machines take the heavy fighting, so people wear the lightest, most refined kit of the war: spell-corps grey-blue tunics with three rings on the left breast and glowing circuit lines engraved at the cuffs, crystal-set bracers, a row of crystal cells at the belt, sometimes a forbidden life-draining crystal case, scouts in copper-soled boots, rune lines that flicker near the death frontier; winders in pocketed aprons with wrenches and brass tuning pins; colossus crews in furnace-badged leather aprons with a small mica-shielded lamp; beast-hunters with greatsword and longsword; boiling-blood fighters with red glowing under the skin and white steam rising; demon side: wolf-makers in bone-carved bracers hung with bone charms, winged couriers with wing slits in their jerkins and bone rings on the wrists, bull-demons with an iron band on one horn and a gate-breaking hammer, a long-lived halberdier in old leather with an embroidered cuff, fire still burning on the horns.
号角: no gunpowder, no guns. The last centuries: old enchanted plate patched and inherited, its rune lines dimmed but still flickering, crystal sockets refilled with fresh crystals, heirloom longbows wrapped in layered leather bands, the better blades forged of orichalcum; highland riders of great storm eagles; adventurers dressed as themselves, not in corps kit; after the armistice weapons come off, a bowstring tied at the wrist; demon side: fire-horned warriors breaking through the wall with molten trails behind them, bone-carvers whose script stands the dead back up, winged warriors with bone javelins, the oath-faction's high priest with eleven bowl rims strung at his neck, obsidian horn-rings worn openly or wrapped in cloth after the armistice.
